project: JARVIS TRADER — Agent 3: Portfolio Correlation Monitoring
description: Add position correlation monitoring to the multi-market orchestrator. MNQ and MES are equity index futures with ~0.95 correlation. Running both simultaneously creates concentrated exposure that the current system does not account for. This adds correlation-aware position sizing and a new risk endpoint.

userStories.title: Map current multi-market orchestrator structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to understand the current orchestrator before modifying it to avoid breaking existing MCL/MNQ trading.
acceptanceCriteria: Read engine/markets/orchestrator.py fully
Document in progress.txt: how instruments are registered, how positions are tracked, where sizing decisions are made
Identify the exact functions/methods to modify for correlation-aware sizing
Identify any existing tests in engine/tests/ that cover orchestrator behavior
No code changes in this story — analysis only
userStories.notes: Do not break existing MCL/MNQ behavior. The correlation rule only applies to equity index pairs (MNQ+MES).

userStories.title: Add correlation matrix to orchestrator
userStories.description: As the risk system, I want a static correlation matrix defined in the orchestrator so position sizing can account for instrument correlations.
acceptanceCriteria: Add INSTRUMENT_CORRELATION dict to engine/markets/orchestrator.py or engine/config.py
Values: MCL-MNQ: 0.10, MCL-MES: 0.10, MNQ-MES: 0.95 (equity index correlation)
Add method get_portfolio_correlation_exposure() that returns current cross-instrument exposure
Method considers open positions only (not pending orders)
Unit test: test_correlation_exposure_calculation in engine/tests/test_orchestrator.py (create if not exists)
Typecheck: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m mypy engine/markets/orchestrator.py --ignore-missing-imports
Commit: feat: add instrument correlation matrix to multi-market orchestrator
userStories.notes: Keep the correlation values in config.py not hardcoded in orchestrator.py — follow existing patterns

userStories.title: Implement correlation-aware position sizing rule
userStories.description: As the risk system, I want MNQ and MES position sizes automatically reduced when both instruments have simultaneous open positions.
acceptanceCriteria: When MNQ has open position AND MES has open position: max_contracts for each reduces to 1 (from 2)
When only one of MNQ/MES has position: max_contracts stays at 2
MCL is unaffected by this rule
Rule is applied in position sizing calculation BEFORE order submission
Rule is logged: 'Correlation reduction applied: MNQ+MES both open, max_contracts → 1'
Unit test for rule application
Commit: feat: correlation-aware position sizing — MNQ+MES max 1 contract each when both open
userStories.notes: This rule must pass through the SafetyLayer before execution — verify it doesn't conflict with existing risk checks

userStories.title: Add GET /portfolio/risk endpoint
userStories.description: As the dashboard, I want a REST endpoint that returns current portfolio correlation exposure so it can be displayed in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: New endpoint: GET /portfolio/risk
Response schema: {"instruments": [...], "correlation_matrix": {...}, "active_positions": [...], "correlation_reduction_active": bool, "total_margin_utilization": float, "daily_pnl_pct": float}
Endpoint is read-only and does not modify any state
Add to appropriate router in engine/routers/
Add to main.py router registration if new router
Smoke test: curl http://localhost:8010/portfolio/risk
Commit: feat: add GET /portfolio/risk endpoint with correlation matrix
userStories.notes: Follow existing router patterns. Use fetchEngine in dashboard — do not hardcode localhost:8010

userStories.title: Add correlation warning to RiskManagerAgent
userStories.description: As the RiskManagerAgent, I want to include correlation exposure in my risk assessment so high-correlation positions are flagged in the pipeline output.
acceptanceCriteria: RiskManagerAgent reads correlation exposure from orchestrator
When correlation_reduction_active=True, adds warning to risk assessment: 'CORRELATION WARNING: MNQ+MES simultaneous position — size reduced to 1 contract each'
Warning is visible in pipeline output (Stage 4)
Does not add VETO for correlation — only a warning. The sizing rule already handles it.
Commit: feat: add correlation exposure warning to RiskManagerAgent

userStories.title: Run full test suite and verify no regressions
userStories.description: As a developer, I want confidence that the correlation monitoring changes don't break existing MCL/MNQ trading behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/ -v — 0 failures
cd dashboard && pnpm run build — passes
curl http://localhost:8010/health — 200 OK
curl http://localhost:8010/portfolio/risk — returns valid JSON
Commit: test: correlation monitoring full suite verification
